rooms.name: Mountain Pass
rooms.desc:
A shoddy looking gravelly path leads up into the mountain range.  The
stonesky mountains loom high above you, and block out all view of the
terrain hidden beyond them.

rooms.name: A Mountain Pass
rooms.desc:
You stand at the base of the stonesky mountains.  The rough, rocky facade
of the mountain side makes scaling the mountain possible.  As you look up
the immense mountain before you, you notice most of the mountain face is
climbable, and leads off into different directions, broken up by an
occasional ledge for sideways travel.  You sense that climbing won't be a 
problem as much as navigating will be...

rooms.name: The Mountainside
rooms.desc:
While scaling the mountainside, you notice that a ledge is extending off
to the side.  Considering how far you'd drop if you fell, your thankful that
there is an occasional ledge to walk across.

rooms.name: The Mountainside
rooms.desc:
The rock face here leads up or down.  You silently pray that you don't
accidentally let go, as it would be a while before you hit bottom...

rooms.name: A Cloudy Mountain Peak
rooms.desc:
You have reached the pinnacle of one of the mountains.  Clouds and mist
swirl about you in the thin mountain air, blocking view of the world far
below you.  The clouds almost block out the sun, not so much as to create
darkness, but to cast the area in shadow.  You feel lightheaded this high
up, possibly from the climb to get here, or more likely the thin air your
breathing.

rooms.name: A Mountain Pass
rooms.desc:
You are walking across a narrow ledge expanding across the face of the
mountain.  An occasional cave has been cut into the mountain's face, none
big enough to explore.  While you wouldn't dare look down the face of the
mountain, the view of the world far below is breathtaking.

rooms.name: A Dark Mountain Path
rooms.desc:
This part of the mountain range is strangely almost devoid of life.  
There is an occasional dried out husk of a corpse with a terrified look on
their face, but little more.  Even the view here seems oddly disconcerting.
Is this area cursed, or is it something far far worse?
